name: 84040 · Layton, UT
findings: ZIP 84040 (Layton) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84040 (Layton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84040 (Layton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
